citations.assessment: The source gives both R. Yirmeyah and Shmuel bar Ḥalafta, with [Rav] Adda bar Aḥvah in brackets. Heilprin spells ben Ḥalafta and uses his own formula.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The parallel in the beginning of Yerushalmi Megillah reads Ḥalaf and gives the same prayer instruction in Rav Adda bar Aḥvah’s name.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
